scripts.test: cargo test --locked && node --test tests/differential.mjs && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.bench:smoke: node bench/run.mjs repeats=1 warmup=5 samples=10 engines=original,js,wasm,packed-js out=work/bench-smoke
scripts.bench:full: node bench/run.mjs repeats=7 warmup=60 samples=180 engines=original,js,wasm,packed-js out=work/bench-full
scripts.bench:diagnostic: node bench/run.mjs repeats=1 warmup=30 samples=60 engines=original,js,wasm,packed-js timings=true gpu=true out=work/bench-diagnostic
scripts.bench:analyze: node bench/summarize.mjs bench/results/m2-full && node bench/analyze.mjs bench/results/m2-full
scripts.test:progress: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_progress.py && node tests/progress.mjs
